description: Uniparts India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies engineering systems, solutions, and assemblies primarily for off-highway vehicles in India, the United States, the Asia Pacific, Europe, Japan, and internationally. The company offers 3-point linkage systems, including rear and front hitch; precision machined parts, such as pins, brushes, and others; and fabrication products comprising frame coupler, trailer hitch and drawbars, and other applications, as well as power take-off products and hydraulic cylinders. It serves the agriculture, construction, forestry, mining, and aftermarket sectors, as well as original equipment manufacturers. Uniparts India Limited was founded in 1984 and is based in Noida, India.
